tytul: Canned cabbage with mushrooms: why not to can it
wstep: This card has no recipe, because the sources give no safe way to can cabbage with mushrooms.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.
Wild mushrooms must not be canned.

akapity: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning vegetables, and a boiling-water bath means a real risk of botulism for them.
According to Penn State Extension, cabbage is not suitable for pressure canning.
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods are above the safe pH limit unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar.
